falseSynonyms.zh: 一餐不等於 diet meal 是一次早餐、午餐或晚餐；diet 是長期飲食模式或整體攝取。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A meal is one eating occasion; a diet is a broader pattern.

falseSynonyms.zh: 餐牌／餐單不等於 diet menu 是可選菜式或列出的餐點；diet 是實際長期吃甚麼。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A menu lists available or planned dishes; a diet is what is actually consumed over time.

falseSynonyms.zh: 食譜不等於 diet recipe 是製作一道食物的方法；diet 是整體飲食。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A recipe explains how to prepare a dish; it is not an eating pattern.

falseSynonyms.zh: 營養不等於 diet nutrition 是食物和營養素對身體的供應／作用；diet 是所吃食物的模式。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Nutrition concerns nourishment; diet concerns food intake and eating patterns.

falseSynonyms.zh: 食慾不等於 diet appetite 是想吃東西的慾望；diet 是實際吃甚麼和如何吃。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Appetite is desire to eat; diet is actual intake or pattern.

falseSynonyms.zh: 卡路里不等於 diet calories 是能量單位或能量攝取的一部分；diet 包含更多食物和營養資訊。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Calories are one component of dietary intake, not the whole diet.

falseSynonyms.zh: meal plan 只在特定 sense 接近 diet meal plan 是預先安排的餐次；自然形成的日常飲食不一定有任何計劃。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A meal plan is organised in advance; a diet may simply be habitual.

falseSynonyms.zh: 節食不等於 diet dieting 通常表示為減重或其他目標而刻意控制飲食；diet 本身可完全中性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Diet is neutral; dieting usually implies deliberate restriction or control.
